es-ES.description:
Semora es un planificador académico con IA, escáner de temarios, agenda de tareas y grabadora de clases para estudiantes universitarios.

Escanea un temario desde una foto o un PDF, conecta Canvas, Blackboard o Moodle, graba clases, crea transcripciones y apuntes, controla tareas, exámenes y calificaciones, y organiza todas tus fechas importantes.

Tú revisas todo antes de guardarlo.

Convierte tu programa de curso en un semestre organizado.

Semora es un planificador académico con IA para organizar tareas, exámenes, calificaciones, fechas de entrega y clases en un solo lugar.

Haz una foto de tu programa de curso (syllabus), sube un PDF o pega el texto. Semora identifica tareas, exámenes, cuestionarios, proyectos, lecturas, fechas límite, horarios y ponderaciones de calificaciones.

Tú revisas todo antes de guardarlo.

TU SEMESTRE, ORGANIZADO

Abre Semora y sabrás qué hacer después.

«Lo siguiente» muestra tu próxima tarea importante. Las entregas atrasadas se señalan claramente y puedes ver lo que vence hoy, esta semana y más adelante.

Introduce una calificación y Semora calcula automáticamente tu porcentaje y nota ponderada utilizando únicamente el trabajo ya evaluado.

Tu calendario académico organiza tareas, clases, fechas límite y horas de atención por curso.

CONECTA TUS CLASES

Conecta Canvas, Blackboard o Moodle para importar automáticamente tus clases y tareas. Los tres están incluidos en el plan gratuito, sin límite de clases sincronizadas.

Comparte y únete a Espacios de Curso para mantener tareas y fechas sincronizadas con tus compañeros.

ESTUDIA, NO SOLO PLANIFIQUES

Semora Pro incluye:

• Smart Plan basado en tus fechas reales
• Tutor con IA que entiende tus cursos y materiales
• Grabación de clases con transcripción
• Apuntes de estudio generados con IA
• Tarjetas con repetición espaciada
• Cuestionarios de práctica
• Pronóstico de calificaciones
• Alertas de riesgo académico
• Planificación de carga de trabajo
• Temporizador de enfoque
• Recordatorios personalizables
• Sincronización con el calendario
• Cursos y semestres ilimitados
• Creación de Espacios de Curso

EN TODOS TUS DISPOSITIVOS

Tu semestre se mantiene sincronizado entre iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch y la web con una sola cuenta.

Añade el widget «Lo siguiente» a tu pantalla de inicio para ver tu próxima fecha límite sin abrir Semora.

EL PLAN GRATUITO NO CADUCA

Incluye:

• Clases ilimitadas sincronizadas desde Canvas, Blackboard o Moodle
• Un curso añadido manualmente dentro de un semestre
• Una acción de IA durante la vida de tu cuenta

en-US.description:
Semora is an AI student planner, syllabus scanner, Canvas assignment tracker, lecture recorder, and study-notes app for college students.

Scan a syllabus from a photo or PDF, connect Canvas, Blackboard or Moodle, record lectures, create transcripts and notes, track homework, exams and grades, and organize every deadline in one place.

You review everything before it is saved.

Turn your syllabus into an organized semester.

Semora is an AI student planner for assignments, exams, grades, deadlines, classes, and study planning — all in one place.

Take a photo of your syllabus, upload a PDF, or paste the text. Semora identifies assignments, exams, quizzes, projects, readings, due dates, class meetings, office hours, and grade weights.

You review everything before it's saved.

SEE YOUR SEMESTER CLEARLY

Open Semora and know what matters next.

Next Up shows your upcoming work. Overdue assignments are flagged clearly, and you can see what's due today, this week, and later without scrolling through a long task list.

Enter a score and Semora automatically updates your weighted course grade, including your current percentage and letter grade based only on work that has actually been graded.

Your academic calendar organizes deadlines, class meetings, and office hours by course.

CONNECT YOUR CLASSES

Connect Canvas, Blackboard, or Moodle to automatically bring your classes and assignments into Semora. All three are included on the free plan, with no limit on how many classes you sync.

Join Course Spaces shared by classmates to keep course deadlines and assignments in sync. Pro members can create and host Course Spaces.

STUDY, DON'T JUST PLAN

Semora Pro includes:

• Smart Plan built around your real deadlines
• AI Tutor grounded in your syllabus and course materials
• Lecture recording and AI study notes
• Flashcards with spaced repetition
• Practice quizzes
• Grade forecasting and custom grade scales
• Academic Risk alerts
• Workload planning
• Progress Insights
• Focus timer
• Customizable reminders
• Calendar sync
• Unlimited courses and semesters
• Course Space hosting

ON ALL YOUR DEVICES

Your semester stays synced across iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and the web with one account.

Add the Next Up widget to your Home Screen to see your next deadline without opening Semora.

THE FREE PLAN DOESN'T EXPIRE

Free includes:

• Unlimited classes synced from Canvas, Blackboard, or Moodle
• One manually added course within one semester
• One lifetime AI action — use it for a syllabus scan, lecture recording, or turning a document into notes
• Assignment and deadline tracking
• Weighted grade tracking
• Academic calendar
• Same-day reminders
• Joining shared Course Spaces

Upgrade to Semora Pro for unlimited manually added courses and semesters, more AI actions, and advanced study tools.

Scan your syllabus. Organize your semester. Know what to do next.

SEMORA PRO

• Monthly: $4.99/month
• Annual: $29.99/year

Semora Pro is an auto-renewable subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID and renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID subscription settings.

review.notes:
Apple Watch support is included in this version. The Watch app works as a companion to the signed-in iPhone app and receives study data through WatchConnectivity.

To test Record Lecture:
1. Open a course and select Notes > Add > Record Lecture.
2. Confirm recording permission and tap Record while Semora is in the foreground.
3. Lock the iPhone or open another app. Recording continues using the active background audio session.
4. Return to Semora and tap Stop.
5. Semora displays upload and transcription progress, then creates the transcript, structured notes, quiz, flashcards and action items.

The microphone starts only after the user explicitly begins a recording. Version 1.15 uses native continuous capture and closes local audio chunks without restarting the microphone at each chunk boundary.
